onb.step.0.title: What do you work on most?
onb.step.0.sub: Choose one or more; the first is the main one. The workspace is built around it.
onb.step.1.title: Choose a look
onb.step.1.sub: Colours, corners, font and density in one preset. It applies at once.
onb.step.2.title: Choose the icons
onb.step.2.sub: Each row shows the ribbon in that set; the first button is drawn active.
onb.step.3.title: Menu and density
onb.step.3.sub: How much the ribbon shows, how tight rows are, the face and the scale.
onb.step.4.title: Your workspace
onb.step.4.sub: This is what you get. Press Start to begin.
onb.keys: Alt+→ next · Alt+← back · Esc skip
onb.later: Everything can be changed later in Settings → Appearance.
onb.focus.none: Nothing chosen: the workspace stays as it is.
